title.narrative: National Programme for Tuberculosis Control and Chest Diseases , Ministry of Health and Indigenous Medicine - Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Sri Lanka, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (MOH)This program has the following goals: Reduction of TB prevalence by 8% by 2018. The objectives of this program are: Detect at least 84% of incident TB cases (all forms) by 2018. Engage 30% of all private health care providers (hospitals and General Practitioners) in TB control by 2017. Ensure that quality TB services in line with current international standards are provided by qualified and regularly supervised personnel at 100% of all implementation sites. Increase the treatment success rate to at least 90 % of the enrolled patients (all forms of non-MDR TB); successfully treat 75% of MDR-TB cases. Integrate TB diagnostic- and treatment services to include 40% of all hospitals at the level of Divisional Hospitals Type B or above by 2017

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LKA-T-MOHP01
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of children <5 in contact with TB patients who began isonizide preventive therapy
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Impact indicators targets and results for LKA-T-MOHP01
Outcome indicators targets and results for LKA-T-MOHP01
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
